unexpected-operatorsTitle: The result includes operators I do not own
saved-boxTitle: The setup dialog opens at step 2
saved-boxBody: A Box is already saved in this browser. Select step 1, “Operator Data”, at the top of the dialog to return to source selection.
box-not-appliedTitle: I changed the Box, but the result did not change
box-not-appliedBody: Make sure the current data is no longer the max-level sample. Select “Finish”, return to the calculator, and generate again. Existing results do not update automatically.
busyTitle: Too many requests or concurrency limit reached
busyBody: Stop clicking repeatedly and wait as instructed. If the service remains busy, try again later. Your imported Box stays in the browser.
